subject: BlackRock Azure listing — commercial & entitlement playbook
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@blackrock.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlackRock Azure listing — commercial & entitlement playbook

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I wanted to put a concise commercial + entitlement playbook on paper so procurement/legal have a single reference for next steps. High level:

- Offer type: Azure Marketplace Private Offer (publisher-managed merchant-of-record)
- Commercials: list price = $X, marketplace transaction fee pass-through; proposed co-sell revenue split: 78/22 (Redwood/Marketplace) per initial guidance (we can log exact split in the SOW exhibit)
- Entitlement: we need a SKU-to-internal-contract mapping from BlackRock so we can wire entitlement IDs for automated provisioning (see attached template: entitlement-mapping-BLK.xlsx)
- Billing & PO: BlackRock to issue PO referencing Redwood merchant ID + Azure private offer order id; expected invoice cadence: monthly net-30 unless otherwise specified in PO
- Compliance: BlackRock requested SOC2 evidence + data residency attestation; attached SOW includes a vendor evidence checklist for your security team

Immediate asks (to keep the marketplace timeline in the next 3 weeks):
1) Procurement: confirm PO timeline and billing contact (procurement@blackrock.com worked in the call notes)
2) Legal: Jamie / counsel to confirm whether BlackRock needs a redline to the standard Redwood MSA or whether the private-offer can flow under BlackRock standard PO terms. If you want redlines, please send a mark-up to irene@redwood.com by Friday 9/17 so we can align with Azure listing deadlines.
3) Entitlements: fill the SKU mapping spreadsheet and return; we’ll produce entitlement IDs and demo the entitlement flow to your SRE.

I’ve attached a draft SOW (BLK-SOW-DRAFT-v3.docx) with a short commercial exhibit. If you want, we can put together a one-page commercial summary for your procurement system to attach to the PO.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth marketplace listing.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---

From: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@blackrock.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@blackrock.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: BlackRock Azure listing — commercial & entitlement playbook

Vivek —

Thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick notes from procurement/legal before we route back:

- PO timeline: draft PO ready by 9/22; approvals expected 9/29. We have an internal requirement to reference our master procurement exhibit; happy to try the standard PO flow first, but legal will likely want to review the MSA redlines you mentioned.
- Payment terms: BlackRock standard is net-45 for new vendors; we can escalate for net-30 if there is urgency. Please indicate whether Redwood can accept net-45 or needs net-30.
- Entitlements: we will fill the SKU mapping template and return by EOD Thu 9/17.
- SOC2: procurement has requested the SOC2 ID/letter; we’ll have our security team validate the evidence.

Jamie Carter
Vendor Programs — Cloud Services
BlackRock

---

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: BlackRock Azure listing — commercial & entitlement playbook

Team —

Quick legal read:
1) MSA redlines: BlackRock will almost certainly push for expanded indemnity and audit rights. Our starting position: limit indemnity to third-party IP and gross negligence; cap liability to standard SaaS carve-outs (2x fees for the first 12 months, not unlimited). If procurement insists on PO-only terms, we need a short exception memo signed by legal to allow marketplace flow under PO terms.
2) Data residency: the SOW currently states US-only processing for this private offer. If BlackRock requires EU/UK residency for any sub-accounts, we’ll need to scope a regional deployment and update pricing.
3) SOC2 evidence: attach the SOC2 report cover page + system description. I’ll prepare a redline to the SOW to add the evidence checklist and a minimal SLA exhibit for uptime/response credits.

I’ve added short inline comments to BLK-SOW-DRAFT-v3.docx; Marissa, can you coordinate finance on the payment term tolerance? Rishi — want your input on whether we can accept net-45 for initial onboarding and switch to net-30 post-priority onboarding credit?

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: BlackRock Azure listing — commercial & entitlement playbook

Agree with Irene. Finance notes:
- Net-45 acceptable for first 2 invoices to avoid blocking listing; after that we can request net-30 via a billing addendum tied to merchant onboarding completion.
- Need the exact merchant-of-record ID and invoice remittance address to populate our billing templates. Vivek, if we fast-track the invoice flow we may be able to meet BlackRock’s 9/29 approval with invoice issuance starting Oct 1.

I will draft a short billing addendum template and send to procurement@blackrock.com once Jamie confirms remittance details.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: procurement@blackrock.com <procurement@blackrock.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@blackrock.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: BlackRock Azure listing — commercial & entitlement playbook

Vivek / team —

Thanks — procurement confirms:
- We will issue a PO by 2026-09-22 referencing the draft SOW and the Azure private offer ID once you provide the merchant ID.
- Payment terms: approved net-45 for the first two invoices; net-30 thereafter. Please confirm merchant remittance ID and the legal entity name to put on the PO (we need exact wording).
- Legal asks: please send a clean MSA extract and the proposed liability cap language; we will route to counsel the same day we receive it.
- Entitlements: receiving the completed spreadsheet by EOD 9/17 will keep the provisioning timeline intact.

Procurement Team
BlackRock
